[[File:Kim Burns DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kim Burns at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Kim Burns''' was a Super Volunteer ("Super Vol") at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="fri26">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri26.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri26], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Evan Lorentz and Super Vol Kim Burns tell Star Wars Insider writer Richard Handley what's happening with the Star Trek CCG World Finals". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001024231109/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri26.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sun13">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun13.html DecipherCon 1999 Sunday photo sun13], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Super Vol, super guy, Trevor Hinkley of Santa Barbara, CA is helping run DecipherCon events". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000519013144/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun13.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="fri22">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri22.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri22], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Super-volunteer Trevor Hinkley and Decipher's Kendrick Summers share a moment". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000529012218/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri22.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher photographed her with [[Evan Lorentz]] and ''Star Wars Insider'' writer [[Richard Handley]] during the Star Trek CCG World Finals.<ref name="fri26" />
